instagram.caption:
Next month Voyager 1 becomes the first thing we ever built to sit one light-day from Earth 🛰️

Voyager 1 launched in 1977, flew past Jupiter and Saturn and crossed into interstellar space in 2012. On November 18, 2026 it reaches one light-day from Earth, about 16.1 billion miles, so a radio signal takes a full day each way. Its transmitter runs on about 23 watts, and as its plutonium power fades, engineers keep switching systems off to keep it talking.
